# defectdojo_sla_configuration (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a DefectDojo SLA configuration by ID or name, such as the `Default` one that DefectDojo creates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_sla_configuration" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}

data "defectdojo_sla_configuration" "by_id" {
  id = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the SLA configuration to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) The name of the SLA configuration to look up, compared exactly. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `critical` (Number) The number of days in which critical findings must be remediated.
- `description` (String) The description of the SLA configuration.
- `enforce_critical` (Boolean) Whether critical findings get an SLA expiration date.
- `enforce_high` (Boolean) Whether high findings get an SLA expiration date.
- `enforce_low` (Boolean) Whether low findings get an SLA expiration date.
- `enforce_medium` (Boolean) Whether medium findings get an SLA expiration date.
- `high` (Number) The number of days in which high findings must be remediated.
- `low` (Number) The number of days in which low findings must be remediated.
- `medium` (Number) The number of days in which medium findings must be remediated.
- `restart_sla_on_reactivation` (Boolean) Whether findings that a reimport reactivates get a new SLA period.
